company.name: Audible
company.shortDescription: Audible provides audiobooks, podcasts, and original audio content through digital listening services.
company.description: Audible provides digital access to audiobooks, podcasts, and original audio programs. Its catalog includes fiction, nonfiction, educational material, radio programs, and other spoken-word content. Audible offers subscription plans that provide monthly audiobook selections or credits, along with access to a catalog of included titles for eligible members. Users can stream or download content through Audible applications and listen online or offline. The company also produces and distributes Audible Originals and other exclusive audio programs.
